sections.label: No illegal oil discharge incidents
sections.summary: MPA has not detected incidents of ships deliberately and illegally discharging oil from engine rooms in the last five years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: MPA has not detected incidents involving ships deliberately and illegally discharging oil from their engine room in the last five years.

sections.label: Measures against illegal oily discharge
sections.summary: MPA has implemented measures to monitor and ensure ships in Singapore waters do not illegally discharge oily wastewater into port waters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: MPA also has implemented measures to monitor and ensure that ships in our waters are not illegally discharging oily wastewater into Singapore port waters.
